cover_hook: These lemurs sing using an opera singer's trick
caption_hook: 🎶 Madagascar's singing lemurs open their mouths wider for high notes, just like opera sopranos + 3 more wins 👇
question: Opera-singing lemurs or tiny dancing stars: which made your day? 👇
share_line: Send this to the friend who sings in the shower

first_comment: Bonus: the indri is the only lemur known to sing, and its songs carry through dense rainforest so family groups can keep in touch. Which animal would you want to hear sing? 🎤

stories.headline: Singing lemurs hit high notes the way sopranos do
stories.summary: Scientists filmed 19 wild indris in 83 videos and found they open their mouths wider as their pitch rises, the same 'formant tuning' trick opera sopranos use to sound louder without straining.
stories.why: Humans and indris found the same vocal trick on their own, tens of millions of years apart.

stories.stat_label: for one full orbit of the pair
stories.headline: China's giant dish finds the lightest pair of dead stars yet
stories.summary: Using the FAST telescope, which has found about 900 pulsars, astronomers weighed a neutron-star pair at just 2.49 Suns combined, the lightest known. They whirl round each other every 2.36 hours.
stories.why: Their slowly shrinking orbit matches Einstein's predictions, making them a fresh test of relativity.

stories.stat_label: religious find in this Roman village
stories.headline: Volunteers help unearth a rare Roman Venus statuette
stories.summary: Students, archaeologists and local history volunteers digging a Roman village near Budapest found a small lead statue of Venus, plus coins, brooches, a mirror fragment and an intact pair of iron tongs.
stories.why: It's the first religious object found in this village, a glimpse of what its people believed.

stories.headline: A drug built for one ALS patient shows early promise
stories.summary: Mayo Clinic and the nonprofit n-Lorem screened 320+ candidates to build a genetic medicine for a single patient with a rare form of ALS. A key marker of nerve damage responded quickly.
stories.why: Made-for-one medicines could open doors for people with ultra-rare diseases.

fun_fact: The indri is the largest living lemur and the only lemur species known to sing.
